summary: performance lens over actuals-loader (22 product path(s), 66cc8b8..2208b0a, Codex via the autoreview skill at --max-priority P2): 0 blocking, 2 non-blocking. The loader implements the intended contracts and contains no compatibility leftovers, but both protective bounds can be bypassed before they take effect: ZIP entries are counted only after archive materialization, and worksheet traversal is not bounded by the configured row limit. These leave concrete CPU/memory denial-of-service paths in the upload hot path.

non_blocking_findings.summary: Reject ZIP entry bombs before materializing every entry (backend/src/ingest/sap-actuals.parser.ts:176): The 256-entry limit is checked only after `JSZip.loadAsync(buffer)` has parsed and allocated the entire archive directory.

Bound worksheet row iteration independently of mapped data rows (backend/src/ingest/sap-actuals.parser.ts:82): This loop runs through `worksheet.rowCount`, while the 25,000-row limit increments only when a mapped header column is nonblank.
